name: localhost-proxy
description: Opens the crew’s localhost previews and links through Wheelhouse itself, so they work when Wheelhouse runs in Docker, a cloud workspace or another computer.

reported.title: Open ports the crew reports
reported.description: Pass on any port the crew has reported an address on (a live preview, a link in a reply, a status note or a decision card) since Wheelhouse started. Turn this off to open only the ports listed below.

ports.title: More ports to allow
ports.description: Ports on Wheelhouse’s computer to open even when nobody has reported them, separated by commas (for example 3000, 8080). Wheelhouse’s own port is never opened.
